'''Magar's World''' was a brutal, inconsequential backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that did not appear on many [[Star map/Legends|star-charts]]. It was said there were only two real reasons why someone might know of it: that individual either went to see the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] games, or they were among the unlucky beings forced to fight in them.

The despot [[Magar (despot)|Magar]] controlled the illegal games, and life for the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] gladiators and exotic beasts they fought was often extremely short. Successful escapes were rare.
